defects: Back and seat upholstery blend into the dark shell in the production close views.
The broad padded surfaces look plain; the required seams and fabric panels are difficult to read at room scale.
incumbent_comparison: First visually reviewable candidate after the earlier generator parse failure. The silhouette and task-chair parts are clear, but close views show little separation between the near-black shell and upholstery.
likely_causes: The near-black color values are too close under the room's lighting.
Thin seam geometry and low-contrast noise do not create enough visible surface variation.
next_action_hypothesis: Raise the slate-blue fabric values, divide the seat and back into padded panels, and add restrained piping while staying within the same RoomDefinition envelope.

observations.art_direction_fit: The restrained dark palette fits the room and the low-poly visual system, but the chair needs clearer material hierarchy to avoid reading as one dark block.
observations.close_up_quality: The full chair is framed in the detail render, but the upholstery is visually flat and the seams do not resolve clearly.
observations.gameplay_readability: The chair remains clearly visible beside the desk; the generated scene is presentation-only and the RoomDefinition obstacle remains authoritative.
observations.geometric_detail: The profile reveals five spokes, separate caster housings and wheels, arm pads, back rails, and tilt hardware, but few of these details read from the three-quarter view.
observations.material_realism: The dark metal frame and fabric are distinguishable by highlight only; the seat and back nearly merge into the shell in the inspected three-quarter and detail captures.
observations.proportion: The cushion, tall back, and wheeled base look plausible together, though the blocky back and seat lack shaped padding.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot measured 20.2 x 41.15 x 16.83 inches, which the factory normalized to the 23 x 44 x 18-inch brief without changing RoomDefinition dimensions.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The room and three-quarter views clearly show an office task chair with a tall back, seat, armrests, lift, and five caster base.
observations.silhouette_quality: The upright back, seat, arms, center lift, and five spokes form a recognizable chair silhouette; the squared cushion shape is still plain.
observations.surface_variation: Back quilt channels and seat seam marks exist, but their dark, narrow lines are hard to see in the captured lighting.
observations.technical_integration: The native scene passes Godot validation and the production resolver reports office_chair-v002 with six real RoomScale production captures.
